anya.marketing: Hey @devon.runtime quick sanity ask for launch copy. We want a short verified stat for the hero: "up to 2x inference cost savings vs baseline for interactive chat". Can you run a compact validation and give p50/p95 per-token latency, tokens/sec, and $/1k-token estimates for a small matrix? Need raw CSV and a PNG single-row summary we can screenshot.

devon.runtime: Yep. What model, seq len, sample prompts, concurrency, and exact configs to compare? Also confirm baseline definition (cache off/on, fp16/fp4).

anya.marketing: Model = open-gen-7b-v1 (catalog). Seq len = 256 (web chat median). Two sample payloads: short (~15 tokens) and medium (~220 tokens) multi-turn. Concurrency reference = 5. Compare: hosted-baseline (no-cache, fp16), hosted-cache (cache on, fp16), hosted-quant (cache on, fp4), and dedicated-reserved (a100-small, cache on, fp16). Samples = 25 per config. Please include 95% CI for tokens/sec if possible.

marta.analytics: Please capture per-sample token counts and include CI via bootstrap. Also include model digest/hash.

devon.runtime: queuing small run now. Command: ```redwood-bench run --model open-gen-7b-v1 --seq-len 256 --concurrency 5 --samples 25 --cache {on,off} --variant {fp16,fp4} --env {hosted,dedicated} --out csv --job-id run-20250603-117```

bench-bot: bench-scheduler: Job queued: id=run-20250603-117 queued_by=devon.runtime ETA~45m.

bench-bot: bench-scheduler: Job started: id=run-20250603-117 pool=a100-small.

bench-bot: bench-scheduler: Job complete: id=run-20250603-117 artifacts: https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/run-20250603-117

devon.runtime: Raw summary (concurrency=5, seq=256, 25 samples each):
- hosted-baseline (no-cache, fp16): p50=110ms/token, p95=310ms/token, tokens/sec=82 (95%CI 78-86), est cost=$0.16/1k tokens, samples=25
- hosted-cache (fp16): p50=35ms/token, p95=85ms/token, tokens/sec=260 (95%CI 245-275), est cost=$0.06/1k tokens, samples=25
- hosted-quant (fp4, cache on): p50=70ms/token, p95=165ms/token, tokens/sec=140 (95%CI 132-148), est cost=$0.09/1k tokens, samples=25
- dedicated-reserved (a100-small, cache on): p50=50ms/token, p95=120ms/token, tokens/sec=190 (95%CI 180-200), est cost=$0.08/1k tokens, samples=25
Model digest: open-gen-7b-v1@sha256:ghi789jkl. No unusual retries or queue spikes. CSV: https://bench.redwood.internal/artifacts/run-20250603-117/results.csv PNG: https://bench.redwood.internal/artifacts/run-20250603-117/summary.png

anya.marketing: Great — these show ~3.2x tokens/sec for cache vs baseline on this matrix. For the hero we'll hedge: "Up to ~3x throughput improvement with Redwood's cache-enabled path vs baseline (internal benchmark)" and footnote the job id + link. Jen, ok to proceed?

jen.docs: OK but change "~3x" to "up to 3x" and add: "Measurements from internal benchmark run-20250603-117; results may vary by workload and model version. See appendix for full matrix and CIs." Also include exact command and model digest in PR.

marta.analytics: CSV includes bootstrap CI and per-sample tokens; good to go.

devon.runtime: Uploaded CSV+PNG to job artifacts and added the command in PR. Pinning artifacts: https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/run-20250603-117

anya.marketing: Thanks all 389. Closing this thread.
